pois.label: 洁净室本体（层流 + 黄白双光区）
pois.label_en: The cleanroom (laminar flow, yellow and white bays)
pois.detail: 整个天花板是一块 HEPA 层流送风面，空气从顶到高架孔板地面单向下洗，颗粒没有机会横漂。琥珀色隔断围出黄光区——光刻胶对 450 nm 以下的光敏感，黄光下它才是「瞎的」。进门必须走更衣段：洁净服、换鞋凳、风淋门。
pois.detail_en: The entire ceiling is one HEPA laminar-flow face: air washes straight down from ceiling to perforated raised floor, giving particles no chance to drift sideways. The amber partition fences off the yellow bay - photoresist is sensitive below 450 nm, so only under yellow light is it blind. Entry is through the gowning line: suits, shoe bench, air shower.

specs.气流: 顶置 HEPA 单向层流，全室下洗
specs.分区: 黄光区（涂胶+光刻）／白光区（沉积刻蚀+测试封装）
specs.选址: 地下城岩层——隔绝全球尘暴，光刻平台免振

specs_en.Zones: yellow bay (coat + litho) / white bay (dep-etch + test-package)
specs_en.Siting: undercity bedrock - sealed from global dust storms, vibration-free for litho

sim: 选址账：火星地表尘暴期 PM 浓度可升千倍且尘粒带静电，而洞室岩层温度恒定、无风振——洁净室能耗与滤网寿命都优于地表方案。
层流账（本厂设计轮）：0.35 m/s 单向下洗 16 秒清扫全室；0.5 µm 颗粒在火星重力下靠沉降要 11.5 天——差 6 万倍。火星 g 只有地球 38%,沉降更帮不上忙：洁净靠流场，不靠重力。

20 号仿真给这座厂排了第四类客户:显微镜。冷冻电镜实验室最大的一笔常规进口是载网,φ3.05mm、孔阵 1.2µm——对 130nm 的产线过剩两个数量级。算下来 200mm 晶圆上排 **2876 片**,聚簇良率 94.3% 剩 2712 片好片,而全站一年只用 780 片:**一片晶圆够 3.48 火星年**。配方 8 步 335 分钟、**只要两张新掩模,零新增设备**——LPCVD 低应力 SiN → 光刻孔阵 → RIE → 湿法清洗 → 背面窗口 → 深 RIE → 镀金/碳 → 划片,每一步都落在本厂已有的机台上(闸门 C4 就是逐步核对这份清单)。另加阶段 1 非成像硅三件套:荧光屏相机(15.4mm die,良率 44%)、对中相机(3.8mm,96%)、束流监测(4.0mm,96%),全在现有正照 CIS 流程内,不需背照、不需减薄、不需拼接。产线负荷:**0.29 片晶圆启动/火星年**——第四类客户在排产上是舍入误差,真正的成本是掩模和配方。
sim_en: Siting ledger: surface dust storms raise particulate counts a thousandfold and the dust is electrostatically charged, while the cavern holds constant temperature with zero wind vibration - both HVAC energy and filter life beat any surface option.

Downflow ledger (this fab's design round): the 0.35 m/s unidirectional flow sweeps the room in 16 seconds; a 0.5 um particle settling under Mars gravity would take 11.5 days - a factor of sixty thousand. At 38% of Earth's g, gravity helps even less: cleanliness comes from the flow field, not from falling.

Sim 20 schedules a fourth customer class for this fab: the microscope. The cryo-EM lab's largest routine import is support grids - 3.05 mm discs with a 1.2 um hole array, which a 130 nm line overshoots by two orders of magnitude. A 200 mm wafer holds 2,876 of them; at 94.3% clustered yield that is 2,712 good grids against a station demand of 780 a Mars year, so one wafer covers 3.48 Mars years. The recipe runs eight steps and 335 minutes and needs two new masks and no new equipment at all - low-stress LPCVD nitride, hole-array litho, RIE, wet clean, backside window, deep RIE, gold and carbon, dice - every step landing on a tool this floor already has, which gate C4 checks name by name. Stage-1 non-imaging silicon comes with it: a fluorescent-screen camera (15.4 mm die, 44% yield), an alignment camera (3.8 mm, 96%) and a beam monitor (4.0 mm, 96%), all inside the existing front-illuminated CIS flow - no back-illumination, no thinning, no stitching. Line loading works out at 0.29 wafer starts a Mars year: customer four is a scheduling rounding error, and the real cost is the masks and the recipe.
pois.physics: 层流的要点是「不混合」：单向活塞流让污染物只有一条出路——地板。乱流洁净室靠稀释，层流洁净室靠推走，等级差一个数量级。
pois.physics_en: Laminar flow works by never mixing: piston-like unidirectional flow gives contamination exactly one exit - the floor. Turbulent rooms dilute; laminar rooms push. The difference is an order of magnitude in class.

pois.label: 涂胶显影轨道（黄光区）
pois.detail: 晶圆从前端装载口进轨道：旋涂吸盘 3000 rpm 把光刻胶甩成亚微米均匀膜（透过观察窗能看到吸盘在转），软烘、曝光后再回来显影。它和光刻机是一对——轨道管「涂与显」，光刻机管「曝」。
pois.detail_en: Wafers enter at the front load ports: the spin chuck flings photoresist into a sub-micron uniform film at 3000 rpm (watch it spin through the window), soft-bakes, and after exposure the wafer returns here to develop. Track and stepper are a pair - the track coats and develops, the stepper exposes.

specs.工艺: 涂胶 → 软烘 → (曝光) → 显影 → 坚膜
specs.环境: 全程黄光——胶对 <450 nm 敏感

specs_en.Spin: ~3000 rpm; thickness calibrated against speed squared
specs_en.Ambient: yellow light throughout - resist is sensitive below 450 nm

sim: 膜厚模型：t ∝ 1/√ω 的经验标度配合黏度修正——旋涂是流体力学与蒸发耦合的自限过程，转速与固含量定终膜。

胶显影仿真（本厂设计轮，传输矩阵+Dill/PEB+Mack 显影）：248 nm 下硅面反射 53%，胶内驻波周期 70.5 nm；BARC 抗反射层扫厚定在 108 nm——残余反射压到 0.5%，swing 振幅 0.48→0.06。显影出真剖面：BARC+PEB 30 nm 侧壁 84.6°、缘纹波 1.4 nm；去掉 BARC 同配方要多付 14% 剂量，侧壁纹波涨三倍成扇贝纹——「显影后坚膜前」这段路的物理全部有账。

16 号仿真把「500nm 胶厚」从设定值变成算出来的。旋涂两段:先是甩胶(Emslie-Bonner-Peck)——**液膜会忘记自己的初始厚度**,50µm 和 500µm 起步 60 秒后收敛到 0.05% 以内;再是 Meyerhofer 判据,甩薄速率跌到溶剂蒸发速率以下时膜就定住。有意思的是定住厚度按 ω^(−2/3) 走,而实测的著名指数是 −1/2——差别来自蒸发速率本身随转盘边界层按 √ω 变,补上这一项指数正好是 −0.500,**这才是那个经典 −1/2 的出处**。3000rpm 下算得干膜 510nm(第 4/5/8 轮假设 500)。软烘:菲克脱溶剂的有限差分对上闭式级数解,60 秒后残余溶剂 26%,到 5% 需 148 秒。回灌:转速控制 ±0.5% → 厚度 σ=1.27nm → 经第 4 轮 swing 曲线 → **无 BARC 时 CD 误差 4.9nm,有 BARC 只剩 0.61nm**——涂胶机的精度预算原来是由抗反射层决定的。六闸全绿。
sim_en: Film model: the empirical t proportional to 1/sqrt(omega) scaling with viscosity correction - spin coating is a self-limiting balance of fluid mechanics and evaporation, set by speed and solids content.

Resist simulation (this fab's design round: transfer matrix + Dill/PEB + Mack development): silicon reflects 53% at 248 nm, printing 70.5 nm-period standing waves into the resist; a BARC thickness scan lands on 108 nm, crushing residual reflectivity to 0.5% and the swing amplitude from 0.48 to 0.06. Development yields real profiles: 84.6-degree sidewalls with 1.4 nm edge ripple under BARC + 30 nm PEB; strip the BARC and the same recipe costs 14% more dose while sidewall ripple triples into scallops. The physics between develop and hard-bake is now on the books.

Sim 16 turns the 500 nm resist from a setting into a result. Spin coating goes in two acts: spin-off (Emslie-Bonner-Peck), where the film FORGETS its initial thickness - 50 um and 500 um starts converge to within 0.05% after 60 s - and then the Meyerhofer criterion, where the film sets once thinning falls below the solvent evaporation rate. The set thickness scales as omega^(-2/3), yet the famous measured exponent is -1/2; the difference is that the evaporation rate itself follows sqrt(omega) through the rotating-disk boundary layer, and putting that back gives exactly -0.500. That is where the classic -1/2 actually comes from. At 3000 rpm the dry film lands at 510 nm (rounds 4/5/8 assume 500). Soft bake: a Fickian desorption solved by finite difference against the closed-form series leaves 26% solvent at 60 s, reaching 5% at 148 s. And the loop closes: +-0.5% spin-speed control gives 1.27 nm of thickness spread, which through the round-4 swing curve becomes 4.9 nm of CD error without BARC but only 0.61 nm with it - the coater's precision budget is set by the anti-reflective layer. Six gates green.
pois.physics: 离心力把胶液甩薄，溶剂蒸发让黏度飙升把膜「冻住」——两个过程赛跑，终点就是那层均匀到纳米级的胶膜。
pois.physics_en: Centrifugal force thins the puddle while solvent evaporation spikes viscosity and freezes the film - two processes race, and the finish line is a coating uniform to nanometers.

pois.label: 光刻机（数字线：MB-1 / sky130）
pois.detail: 照明塔的光穿过掩模版、经投影镜筒缩小后落在晶圆上——城里计算中心机架上那颗 MB-1 推理芯片就从这里流出：字符级 bigram 语言模型的 ASIC，sky130 130 nm 工艺，RTL 到 GDS 全开源工具链。
pois.detail_en: Light from the illumination tower passes the reticle and lands on the wafer through the reduction lens. The MB-1 inference chip in the compute-center rack came off this line: a character-level bigram language-model ASIC on sky130 (130 nm), RTL to GDS on a fully open toolchain.

specs.逻辑: ~2100 标准单元（0.033 mm²）——面积由 64 Kbit SRAM 主导
specs.流程: Yosys 综合 → OpenROAD 布局布线 → klayout 合流 GDS（26.3 MB）

specs_en.Logic: ~2100 std cells (0.033 mm2) - area dominated by 64 Kbit SRAM
specs_en.Flow: Yosys synthesis, OpenROAD P&R, klayout merge to a 26.3 MB GDS

sim: MB-1 全流程台账：iverilog+xsim 双仿真器逐拍一致（1,134,185 ns）、Python 金标准位级对拍、FPGA 原型时序 MET（WNS +3.29 ns）；物理设计六坑账里最典型的一条——常量网必须插 tie cell，否则 TritonRoute 直接拒布（DRT-0305）。

光刻成像仿真（Abbe 部分相干空中像，本厂设计轮）：130 nm 密集线在 i-line 365 nm 下衍射级全截止（截止密距 358 nm，对比度=0）；KrF 248 nm/NA 0.63 常规照明 k₁=0.33 也只有对比度 0.15——必须环形离轴照明（0.55–0.85）拉回两束干涉，对比度 0.40、NILS 1.25，空中像焦深随之 >±2 µm。「i-line 干非关键层（≥235 nm）、KrF+离轴干关键层」是衍射物理，不是成本选择。
光刻二轮（工艺窗口+真版图）：6% 衰减相移掩模把 NILS 1.25→1.69、曝光宽容度 11%→15%；MEEF=2.79——掩模误差近三倍放大进晶圆。再把 MB-1 真 GDS 的 poly 层切 5×5 µm 直接成像：392 个栅极采样 CD 散布 1σ=35 nm、线端拉回 29 nm（p95 90 nm）、桥连 0——OPC 与相移掩模不是锦上添花，是把这几笔账逐项抵消的工序。
光刻三轮（OPC 闭环）：工艺锁死、只改掩模，ILT 式像素迭代 12 轮——CD 散布 35→5.9 nm、线端拉回 29→4.6 nm、14 处开路全部救活，hammerhead 在线端自发长出（没人写规则，它是成像物理对「抵消拉回」的解）。「能印→印多准→怎么印准」三问在本厂闭环。
掩模 3D 审判（自研 RCWA，均匀层退化 5×10⁻¹⁶/能量守恒 1.0 双闸门）：73 nm 铬 + 石英的 4× 真掩模,衍射级幅值与薄掩模差 ≤3.4%、相位偏差 ≤5°,晶圆端只剩 −14 nm 焦面漂与 1.4% 剂量误差——Kirchhoff 近似在 130 nm/4× 成立,此前所有成像结论获严格电磁学背书。
物镜账（成像模型反推 + Zemax 实测）：给镜头开需求规格——彗差 7.7 mλ、像散 19 mλ、球差 8.8 mλ,合成 5.5 mλ RMS ≈ λ/181,比通常「衍射极限」（λ/14）严 13 倍;再用 ZOS-API 把 8 片全石英 4× 镜头优化到收敛——NA 0.63 下 896 mλ,离规格 163 倍。「光刻物镜为什么是二十几片的千万美元怪物」,数字自己会说话。

19 号仿真回答了冷冻电镜实验室提的一道选择题:学光罩拼接(4096²×14µm=57.3mm die,是光罩场的 2.2 倍),还是接受免拼接的退路(20.5mm)加 4 倍机时。用本线自己的成像算缝:线跨过拼接缝、上下错位 Δ,直觉是缝处变细直至断裂——**这个直觉是错的**。整个扫描里缝一次都没断,因为 λ/2NA=197nm 的光学分辨率远大于几十 nm 的错位,镜头把台阶抹平了——**这才是拼接可行的物理原因**。真失效是错开的那半向邻线靠拢直至桥连,按 ±10% 预算 **Δ_max=40nm**。套刻预算拆开后:制版 4nm + 物镜场畸变 2nm + 热漂 3nm,RSS 5.4nm,**留给工件台栅格与套刻量测 39.6nm**——按现代口径很宽松。所以**物镜不是绑定项**(第 7 轮 5.5mλ 成像规格在 0.26nm/mλ 下只吃 2nm),绑定项是**本厂从未量过套刻**。决策:分期,一期走退路,拼接二期,准入门槛是先把套刻量出 3σ 并实测拼接 ≤13nm。六闸全绿。
sim_en: MB-1 ledger: dual-simulator lockstep over 1,134,185 ns (iverilog + xsim), bit-exact match against a Python golden model, FPGA prototype timing MET (WNS +3.29 ns). Most quoted of the six physical-design pitfalls: constant nets must get tie cells or TritonRoute refuses to route (DRT-0305).

Imaging simulation (Abbe partially-coherent aerial image, this fab's design round): at 130 nm dense pitch, i-line 365 nm passes zero diffraction orders (cutoff pitch 358 nm, contrast exactly 0); KrF 248 nm / NA 0.63 with conventional illumination manages only 0.15 contrast at k1 = 0.33 - annular off-axis illumination (0.55-0.85) is what rescues it, restoring two-beam interference at contrast 0.40, NILS 1.25, and pushing aerial depth-of-focus beyond +/-2 um. 'i-line for non-critical layers (235 nm and up), KrF plus off-axis for critical ones' is diffraction physics, not a cost choice.

Imaging round 2 (process window + the real layout): a 6% attenuated PSM lifts NILS 1.25 to 1.69 and exposure latitude 11% to 15%; MEEF = 2.79, so mask errors land on the wafer nearly tripled. Then a 5x5 um clip of MB-1's actual poly GDS was imaged directly: 392 gate samples show a 35 nm (1-sigma) proximity CD spread, 29 nm line-end pullback (p95 90 nm), zero bridging - OPC and phase-shift masks are not polish; they are the steps that cancel these exact entries.

Imaging round 3 (closing the loop with OPC): process locked, mask-only correction, 12 ILT-style pixel iterations - CD spread 35 to 5.9 nm, line-end pullback 29 to 4.6 nm, all 14 lost slivers recovered. Hammerheads grew at the line ends by themselves: nobody wrote that rule; it is the imaging physics' own solution to cancelling pullback. Can it print, how accurately, and how to make it accurate - all three questions now close inside this fab.

Mask-3D verdict (in-house RCWA, twin gates: uniform-layer degeneration at 5e-16, energy conservation at 1.0): the real 4x reticle - 73 nm of chrome on quartz - diffracts within 3.4% of the thin mask in amplitude and 5 degrees in phase; at the wafer that prices out to a -14 nm best-focus shift and a 1.4% dose error. Kirchhoff holds at 130 nm / 4x, and every imaging conclusion above now stands on rigorous electromagnetics.

The lens account (spec derived from our imaging model, reality measured in Zemax): the pupil requirement works out to coma 7.7, astigmatism 19, spherical 8.8 milliwaves - 5.5 mlambda RMS combined, about lambda/181, thirteen times tighter than the usual 'diffraction limited' lambda/14. An 8-element all-silica 4x objective, optimized to convergence through the ZOS-API, reaches 896 mlambda at NA 0.63 - 163x off spec. Why litho lenses are twenty-plus-element ten-million-dollar monsters: the numbers speak for themselves.

Sim 19 answers a choice the cryo-EM lab put to this line: learn reticle stitching (4096^2 x 14 um = a 57.3 mm die, 2.2x the reticle field) or take the single-field fallback at 20.5 mm and four times the microscope time. Imaging the seam with this line's own optics kills the intuitive failure mode: a line crossing a stitch with lateral offset was expected to neck and open, and it never did, across the whole sweep - because lambda/2NA = 197 nm of optical resolution is far larger than a misregistration of tens of nm, so the projector simply blurs the jog away. That is WHY stitching is possible at all. The real failure is the jogged half closing on its neighbour until the array bridges, which the line's own +-10% budget puts at 40 nm. Splitting that into an overlay budget - 4 nm reticle placement, 2 nm lens field distortion, 3 nm thermal, 5.4 nm RSS - leaves 39.6 nm for stage grid and overlay metrology, which is generous by modern standards. So the lens is not the binding term (round 7's 5.5 milliwave imaging spec costs only 2 nm at 0.26 nm per milliwave); the binding term is that this fab has never measured overlay at all. Decision: phase it - fallback now, stitching later, gated on measuring overlay to 3 sigma and demonstrating 13 nm on a test reticle. Six gates green.
pois.physics: 投影光刻的分辨率 = k₁·λ/NA——波长、数值孔径、工艺因子三个旋钮。130 nm 节点用 i-line/DUV 已绰绰有余,城内芯片走「够用就好」路线,可靠性优先。
pois.physics_en: Projection litho resolves k1*lambda/NA - wavelength, numerical aperture and process factor are the three knobs. At 130 nm, i-line/DUV has margin to spare; the city's silicon runs a good-enough node with reliability first.

pois.label: 双角度蒸发台（超导线：QP-20 约瑟夫森结）
pois.detail: 开腔可见玄机：样品台是斜的。先斜着蒸一层铝，通氧原位氧化出约 1 nm 的 AlOx 势垒，再从另一个角度蒸第二层铝——两层在掩模桥下交叠出的那一小块,就是约瑟夫森结。玄枢 QP-20 的 40 个结全部出自这台机器。
pois.detail_en: The open chamber shows the trick: the stage is tilted. Evaporate aluminum at one angle, oxidize in situ to grow a ~1 nm AlOx barrier, then evaporate again from the other angle - where the two layers overlap under the shadow-mask bridge, that patch is a Josephson junction. All 40 junctions in the QP-20 came off this tool.

specs.工艺: Dolan 桥双角度蒸发 Al/AlOx/Al
specs.配套: 311 座空气桥跨线（QP-20 v7 版图）

sim: 频率碰撞蒙卡（QP-20 11 号）把修调精度变成了硬指标：σ_EJ=0.5% 时整芯片良率 99.6%,放松到 1% 良率崩塌——这台蒸发台的工艺窗口是由系统仿真反推出来的。
阴影几何账（本厂设计轮）：胶桥抬高 250 nm、桥宽 150 nm、±28.6°（就是眼前样品台的摆角）→ 偏移 137 nm、结交叠 123 nm、结面积 0.025 µm²；敏感度 9.2%/°——要靠几何拿住 0.5% 散布,倾角得复现到 0.054°,做不到。所以修调不是补救，是设计必选项。

17 号仿真接上了这台机器最后一段没账的工艺:充氧辉光里长出的 AlOx 势垒。链条是氧化剂量→势垒厚度→隧穿电阻→临界电流。Cabrera-Mott 薄膜氧化给出剂量等价(压力与时间一比一互换);Simmons 低偏压隧穿加 Ambegaokar-Baratoff 关系(Ic·Rn=πΔ/2e=283µV,对上铝的已知值)反解出:要 10GHz 的 EJ(Ic=20.1nA、Rn=14.0kΩ、RA=345Ω·µm²),**势垒只有 0.69nm**,对应氧化剂量约 2 mbar·s。真正的结论在灵敏度上:隧穿按 e^(2κd) 走,κ=7.25/nm,于是 **σ_Ic=0.5% 要求厚度控制到 0.345 皮米——原子层的 1/811**。这在单点上物理不可能;结之所以能做出来,靠的是面积平均:0.0246µm² 的结上约 3×10⁵ 个原子位点,取其中 4×10⁴ 个独立起伏就能压到实测的 2%。**修调不是优化项而是必需品**——这和第 2 轮 Dolan 几何从倾角复现性(0.054°)得出的结论殊途同归。六闸全绿。声明:Simmons 拟合在(势垒高度,厚度)上著名地简并,0.69nm 是在 φ=2.0eV 前提下的值。
sim_en: The frequency-collision Monte Carlo (QP-20 sim 11) turned trim precision into a hard spec: 99.6% full-chip yield at sigma_EJ = 0.5%, collapsing if relaxed to 1%. This tool's process window was derived backwards from system simulation.

Shadow-geometry ledger (this fab's design round): bridge standoff 250 nm, bridge width 150 nm, tilt +/-28.6 deg - the very angle the stage in front of you rocks to - gives a 137 nm shift, 123 nm overlap, 0.025 um2 junction. Sensitivity is 9.2% per degree: holding a 0.5% area spread by geometry would need the tilt repeatable to 0.054 deg. It can't be. Trim is not a rescue; it is part of the design.

Sim 17 closes the last unaccounted step on this tool: the AlOx barrier grown in the oxygen glow. The chain runs oxidation dose -> barrier thickness -> tunnel resistance -> critical current. Cabrera-Mott thin-film growth gives dose equivalence (pressure and time trade one for one); Simmons low-bias tunnelling plus the Ambegaokar-Baratoff relation (Ic*Rn = pi*Delta/2e = 283 uV, matching the known Al value) inverts to a barrier of just 0.69 nm for a 10 GHz EJ (Ic 20.1 nA, Rn 14.0 kOhm, RA 345 Ohm*um2), reached at an oxidation dose near 2 mbar*s. The real result is the sensitivity: tunnelling goes as exp(2*kappa*d) with kappa = 7.25 per nm, so sigma_Ic = 0.5% demands thickness control of 0.345 picometres - one 811th of an atomic layer. Pointwise that is impossible; junctions work at all because of area averaging, with roughly 3e5 atomic sites across the 0.0246 um2 junction and about 4e4 independent ones needed to reach the 2% that good fabs actually see. Trimming is not an optimisation but a requirement - the same verdict round 2 reached from a completely different direction, via the 0.054 deg tilt repeatability the Dolan geometry would otherwise demand. Six gates green. Declared: the Simmons fit is famously degenerate in barrier height versus thickness, so 0.69 nm is conditional on the declared phi = 2.0 eV.
pois.physics: 约瑟夫森结是超导量子比特唯一的非线性元件:库珀对隧穿过 1 nm 势垒,给出无耗散的非线性电感——没有这 1 nm,transmon 就只是个普通 LC 谐振腔。
pois.physics_en: The Josephson junction is the only nonlinear element in a superconducting qubit: Cooper pairs tunneling through 1 nm of oxide give a dissipationless nonlinear inductance. Without that nanometer, a transmon is just an LC resonator.

pois.label: 刻蚀与沉积（RIE + α-Ta 溅射）
pois.detail: 卧式圆腔是反应离子刻蚀机:等离子体里的离子被鞘层电场垂直加速,物理轰击加化学反应,把光刻图形各向异性地啃进材料。旁边立式腔是磁控溅射台,给超导线沉积 α 相钽基膜——文献里 Ta 膜 transmon 的 T1 已见 300 µs 以上。
pois.detail_en: The horizontal chamber is the reactive-ion etcher: sheath-accelerated ions strike vertically, combining physical bombardment with chemistry to carve the litho pattern anisotropically. The vertical chamber beside it is the magnetron sputter tool depositing alpha-phase tantalum for the superconducting line - Ta-film transmons have shown T1 beyond 300 us in the literature.

specs.RIE: RF 电容耦合等离子体,各向异性刻蚀
specs.溅射: α-Ta 基膜(高阻硅衬底)——低表面参与损耗
specs.模拟线纪律: CRN65LP 65 nm:DTI 版图铁律等 6 条工艺规则账

specs_en.Sputter: alpha-Ta base film on high-resistivity Si - low surface participation loss
specs_en.Analog-line discipline: CRN65LP 65 nm: six process-rule ledgers incl. the DTI layout iron law

sim: 模拟线(SPAD 读出芯片)的验证账最重:Calibre DRC 迭代 ~29 轮(arr4 从 51 违例清到 0)、LVS 11 次全 CORRECT、xRC 寄生提取 3 次、后仿 4 次——版图不是画完就完,是被规则库逼着收敛的。
沉积续账（本厂设计轮,蒙卡弹道三闸:平坦均匀/槽底首通量=视角因子 0.244≈0.243/CVD 极限共形 0.88）：溅射这类直线飞行沉积在 AR2 深槽底只剩 24% 覆盖——视角因子说了算;要填深槽得靠低黏附多次反弹的 CVD 路线。侧壁 Lambert 再发射的角度权重写反,粒子会顺墙爬逃、槽底饿死——闸门当场抓获。

14 号仿真把这台机器的等离子体本身算了:玻姆流→数值积分泊松方程解出 Child 鞘层(3.23mm,与解析式差 0.02%)→蒙卡追离子穿过射频调制且含电荷交换的鞘层→得到能量分布(均值 190eV,低能尾来自 1.17 次/程的电荷交换)与角分布(均值 0.79°)。于是各向异性 A=0.963 **不再是输入而是算出来的**——它由角分布唯一决定,无自由参数;选择比 S 则不然:纯溅射产额只给到 1.33,远低于氟碳刻蚀实际的 3–5,缺的正是氟碳聚合物钝化层(氧化物自己放出的氧把它吃薄,所以膜上 1.5nm、胶上 3.0nm)。把算出的 (0.963, 3.61) 回灌第 8 轮蚀刻,膜 CD 从 138 nm 变 150 nm——旧账假设的 A=0.9 偏保守了 12 nm。十道已知答案闸全绿。

21 号仿真的另一半落在这台机器上,而且给的不是「一个间隙」而是**禁区带**。射频峰值 450V(第 14 轮:300V 直流 + 150V 射频)下,击穿电压低于 450V 的间隙区间:30mTorr 工艺点 **16.5–113.7cm**(分米量级=腔体尺度,所以电极背后的寄生放电是真实模式);抽气瞬态 1 Torr **0.49–3.41cm**;通大气时 0.009–0.065cm。**最危险的不是工艺点而是抽气瞬态**——腔室会扫过帕邢最低点(舱内气 288V @ 0.97 Torr·cm),而那时禁区正好落在厘米量级,也就是腔内各种结构的尺度。**由此得出的联锁规则:压力必须低于工艺点才允许开 RF,而不是「低于大气压即可」。**
sim_en: The analog line (SPAD readout chips) carries the heaviest verification ledger: ~29 Calibre DRC iterations (arr4 cleaned from 51 violations to 0), 11 LVS runs all CORRECT, 3 xRC parasitic extractions, 4 post-layout sims. A layout is not done when drawn - it is converged under the rule deck.

Deposition continuation (this fab's design round; Monte-Carlo ballistic transport behind three gates: flat uniformity, bottom first-flux equal to the view factor 0.244 vs 0.243, CVD limit conformal at 0.88): line-of-sight deposition like sputtering leaves only 24% coverage at the bottom of an AR-2 trench - the view factor rules; filling deep features takes the low-sticking multi-bounce CVD route. Swap the sine and cosine weights in the sidewall Lambert re-emission and particles crawl up the walls and escape, starving the bottom - caught by the gate on the spot.

Sim 14 computes the plasma itself. Bohm flux -> the Child sheath integrated numerically from Poisson (3.23 mm, 0.02% from the closed form) -> Monte-Carlo ions crossing an RF-modulated, charge-exchanging sheath -> an energy distribution (mean 190 eV, its low-energy tail from 1.17 charge exchanges per crossing) and an angular one (mean 0.79 deg). Anisotropy A = 0.963 is therefore DERIVED, not dialled in: the angular distribution fixes it with no free parameter. Selectivity is a different story - sputter yields alone give only 1.33, far under the 3-5 fluorocarbon etching really delivers, and the missing piece is the polymer passivation layer, kept thinner on oxide (1.5 nm) than on resist (3.0 nm) because the oxide releases its own oxygen. Feeding the derived (0.963, 3.61) back into round 8 moves the film CD from 138 to 150 nm: the old A = 0.9 was 12 nm pessimistic. Ten known-answer gates, all green.

The other half of sim 21 lands on this machine, and what it produces is not a gap number but a FORBIDDEN BAND. At 450 V RF peak (round 14: 300 V dc plus 150 V rf), the gaps whose breakdown voltage falls under 450 V are 16.5 to 113.7 cm at the 30 mTorr process point - decimetre scale, which is chamber scale, so parasitic discharge behind the electrode is a real mode rather than a hypothetical; 0.49 to 3.41 cm during the 1 Torr pump-down transient; and 0.009 to 0.065 cm once vented. The dangerous moment is not the process point but the TRANSIENT: the chamber sweeps through the Paschen minimum (288 V at 0.97 Torr cm in cabin gas) and the forbidden band lands on centimetres, which is the scale of everything inside the chamber. Hence the interlock rule: RF is permitted only below the process pressure, not merely below atmosphere.
pois.physics: RIE 的各向异性来自鞘层:等离子体自建的电位差只沿表面法线加速离子,侧壁几乎不挨打——化学选择性管「刻什么」,离子方向性管「往哪刻」。
pois.physics_en: RIE anisotropy comes from the sheath: the plasma's self-bias accelerates ions only along the surface normal, so sidewalls stay untouched. Chemistry decides what etches; ion directionality decides which way.

pois.label: 探针台（晶圆级测试）
pois.detail: 芯片封装前先在晶圆上「过堂」:探针卡压上焊盘,逐 die 跑测试向量,结果画成墙上那张晶圆图——绿的良品,红的淘汰。witness 结构(陪测件)也在这一步读数:QP-20 每片陪 4 个 SQUID 和 1 个腔,专门用来反推工艺散布。
pois.detail_en: Before packaging, every chip testifies on-wafer: the probe card lands on the pads, test vectors run die by die, and the results paint the wafer map on the wall - green passes, red rejects. Witness structures are read here too: each QP-20 wafer carries 4 SQUIDs and 1 cavity grown purely to measure process spread.

specs.数字线: MB-1 双仿真器 1,134,185 ns 逐拍一致 + FPGA 原型 WNS +3.29 ns
specs.模拟线: px15 后仿 3/3 光子全捕获,arr4 列复用 0101 图形过;蒙卡 trip-point 40 条
specs.超导线: witness 4 SQUID + 1 腔 → σ_EJ 反演

specs_en.Digital line: MB-1 lockstep over 1,134,185 ns + FPGA prototype WNS +3.29 ns
specs_en.Analog line: px15 post-layout 3/3 photons captured, arr4 column-mux 0101 pattern passes; 40 Monte-Carlo trip-points
specs_en.SC line: witness 4 SQUIDs + 1 cavity to invert sigma_EJ

sim: 测试的层级账:仿真金标准(Python 位级)→ 双仿真器对拍 → FPGA 原型 → 晶圆级探针——每一级都在抓上一级抓不到的错,MB-1 曾在对拍层抓出 2 个 RTL 真 bug。
良率统计续账（本厂设计轮,蒙卡三闸:泊松退化/随机复现/复合簇定律双尺度压中）：同一 D₀=6.4/cm²,缺陷若以 8 个一簇出现,MB-1 良率 89.2→97.9%、假想 10× 大 die 31.8→84.7%——聚簇是仁慈的,缺陷互相浪费在同一颗 die 上。机制决定分布族:复合簇=压缩密度泊松,区域涨落=负二项;硬套负二项会得到随尺度漂移的 α。
sim_en: The test hierarchy: Python bit-level golden model, dual-simulator lockstep, FPGA prototype, then wafer probe - each layer catches what the last one cannot. The lockstep layer alone caught 2 real RTL bugs in MB-1.

Yield-statistics continuation (this fab's design round; Monte-Carlo behind three gates: Poisson degeneration, random reproduction, compound-cluster law hitting both scales): at the same D0 = 6.4 per cm2, defects arriving eight to a cluster lift MB-1 yield from 89.2 to 97.9 percent and a hypothetical 10x die from 31.8 to 84.7 - clustering is merciful, defects waste each other on the same die. Mechanism picks the family: compound clusters give a rescaled Poisson, regional density variation gives the negative binomial; force-fitting NB yields a scale-drifting alpha.
pois.physics: 良率是工艺散布的积分:每个 die 是一次对全部工艺参数的抽样。晶圆图上坏品的空间分布本身就是诊断书——边缘环状=旋涂/刻蚀不均,随机散点=颗粒,径向梯度=温度场。
pois.physics_en: Yield is the integral of process spread: every die samples all process parameters at once. The spatial pattern of failures is itself the diagnosis - edge rings mean coat/etch nonuniformity, random specks mean particles, radial gradients mean thermal fields.

pois.label: 划片与键合（封装出厂）
pois.detail: 金刚石刀片把晶圆切成单颗 die,键合机再用金属丝把焊盘连到封装引脚。这里是供应链的出海口:MB-1 装上 PCB 进计算中心机架,QP-20 沿 87 个保序扇出焊盘键合进样品盒、下到玄枢的稀释制冷机。
pois.detail_en: The diamond blade singulates the wafer into dies; the wire bonder then stitches pads to package pins. This bench is the supply chain's port of exit: MB-1 boards into the compute-center rack, and QP-20 bonds out through its 87 order-preserving fanout pads into the sample box bound for the quantum center's fridge.

specs.划片: 金刚石刀片高速切割(观察窗可见)
specs.键合: 楔形键合 Al 丝 / 金丝球焊
specs.下游: MB-1 → 计算中心机架(EasyEDA 实板);QP-20 → 玄枢制冷机 MXC

specs_en.Dicing: high-speed diamond blade (visible through the window)
specs_en.Bonding: Al wedge bond / Au ball bond
specs_en.Downstream: MB-1 to the compute-center rack (fabbed PCB); QP-20 to the quantum center's MXC

sim: QP-20 版图 12 号仿真把键合列进了 DRC:87 个焊盘保序扇出,键合盘间距与压盘检查零违例——封装可行性在版图阶段就闭合,不留给产线猜。

13 号仿真给这张台子记了两笔自己的账。划片:单颗金刚石磨粒的切深 δ=进给/(转速×磨粒数),背面崩边按压痕断裂标度 c∝δ^(2/3) 长大——10mm/s 进给下崩边 p95 = 19.7µm,刀缝 30µm 加两侧崩边共占街区 69.4µm,80µm 街区放得下,极限进给 14.3mm/s。键合:25µm 铝楔焊的变形比窗口 r=w/d∈[1.2,1.8],窗口中点拉力 4.3gf,压在 3gf 规范之上、7.5gf 断线力之下;±8% 变形控制下蒙特卡洛 100% 落窗。三道已知答案门禁(零进给零崩边、2/3 幂自检、MC 对齐解析)全绿。
sim_en: QP-20 layout sim 12 put bonding inside the DRC: 87 pads fan out order-preserved, pad pitch and press-plate checks at zero violations - packaging feasibility closed at layout time, nothing left for the line to guess.

Sim 13 gives this bench two ledgers of its own. Dicing: per-grit engagement delta = feed/(rpm x grits), backside chipping grows by the indentation-fracture scaling c ~ delta^(2/3) - at 10 mm/s the chip p95 is 19.7 um, so 30 um kerf plus both chip margins uses 69.4 um of the 80 um street; max feed 14.3 mm/s. Bonding: the 25 um Al wedge deformation window r = w/d in [1.2, 1.8] gives 4.3 gf pull at center - above the 3 gf spec, below the 7.5 gf wire break; Monte Carlo at 8% deformation control lands 100% in window. Three known-answer gates (zero feed - zero chip, 2/3-power self-check, MC vs analytic) all green.
pois.physics: 键合是固相焊接:超声+压力让金属丝与焊盘界面塑性流动、原子互扩散成键,全程不熔化——对怕热的超导芯片,这是唯一温柔的连接方式。
pois.physics_en: A wire bond is solid-state welding: ultrasonics plus pressure make wire and pad flow plastically and interdiffuse into a bond, nothing ever melting - for heat-shy superconducting chips, the only gentle way to connect.

pois.label: 湿法清洗台（药液三槽）
pois.detail: 台面三只槽从左到右:琥珀色食人鱼液（硫酸+双氧水,烧掉有机残胶）、近透明稀 HF（剥掉自然氧化层,硅表面氢终止）、青色 DI 超纯水冲洗。刻蚀、注入之后,进热工艺之前,晶圆都要来这里过水——颗粒与金属沾污是良率的头号杀手。
pois.detail_en: Three baths left to right: amber piranha (sulfuric acid + peroxide, burns off organic residue), near-clear dilute HF (strips native oxide, leaving hydrogen-terminated silicon), and cyan DI ultrapure rinse. After etch or implant and before any thermal step, every wafer bathes here - particles and metal contamination are yield killer number one.

specs.槽位: 食人鱼 → 稀 HF → DI 冲洗 + 氮气吹干
specs.水质: DI 超纯水,电阻率 18.2 MΩ·cm
specs.排风: 互锁通风柜 + 独立排风立管

specs_en.Baths: piranha, dilute HF, DI rinse + N2 dry
specs_en.Exhaust: interlocked fume sash + dedicated exhaust riser

sim: 良率账在墙上:晶圆图里「随机散点状」坏品的诊断就是颗粒沾污（见探针台卡）——湿法台是把这一项压下去的工位。三条产线共用:sky130 与 CRN65LP 的热工艺前清洗、超导线 α-Ta 沉积前的表面制备。

排放去向（res-recycle-01 危废中和间）：食人鱼液 30 L/sol 经 MnO₂ 分解 H₂O₂ 后用 Ca(OH)₂ 中和成石膏 8.2 kg/sol——正是 res-sulfur-01 回转窑的原料，fab 的废酸最后变回硫和氧；稀 HF 10 L/sol 独立管路独立槽，沉淀成 CaF₂ 0.39 kg/sol（严禁与酸废合流）；fab 中水自成回路，不进城市中水母管、不进农业回路。

15 号仿真给三只槽各记了一笔。食人鱼槽:阿伦尼乌斯活化能 60kJ/mol,120℃ 下 30 秒剥净 500nm 胶,但**每掉 10℃ 速率降 38%**——槽温不是舒适度问题。稀 HF 槽:解出 HF 的电离与二聚平衡(HF₂⁻ 竟贡献 58% 的蚀刻速率),100:1 对热氧化层 2.34nm/min,于是**浸泡窗口 31–77 秒**(下界剥净 1.2nm 自然氧化层,上界守住 3nm 场氧预算);出槽后自然氧化层在洁净室空气里回长,**0.45 小时就到 0.5nm**,这就是排队时限。DI/SC-1 槽:DLVO 势垒决定颗粒是走还是回贴——SC-1(pH10.5)给出 66kT 势垒稳稳赶走颗粒,而**稀 HF 槽自己(pH2,近等电点)势垒是 −0.1kT:颗粒会重新贴上**,这正是 HF 之后必须接冲洗的机制原因。八闸全绿(含 1mM 德拜长度 9.62 vs 教科书 9.6nm)。
sim_en: The yield ledger hangs on the wall: random-speck failures on the wafer map diagnose as particle contamination (see the probe-station card) - this bench is where that line item gets suppressed. All three lines share it: pre-thermal cleans for sky130 and CRN65LP, and surface prep before the alpha-Ta sputter on the superconducting line.

Effluent routing (res-recycle-01 hazmat bay): 30 L/sol of piranha is MnO2-decomposed then lime-neutralised into 8.2 kg/sol of gypsum - the very feedstock of the res-sulfur-01 kiln, so the fab spent acid ends up back as sulfur and oxygen. 10 L/sol of dilute HF runs its own line to its own tank, precipitated as 0.39 kg/sol of CaF2, never commingled with the acid stream. Fab greywater is a loop of its own - it enters neither the city reclaim main nor the farm circuit.

Sim 15 gives each of the three tanks a ledger. Piranha: 60 kJ/mol activation, 500 nm of resist gone in 30 s at 120 C - but every 10 C lost costs 38% of the rate, so tank temperature is not a comfort setting. Dilute HF: solving the ionisation and dimerisation equilibria shows HF2- carrying 58% of the etch rate; 100:1 runs 2.34 nm/min on thermal oxide, which sets a dip window of 31-77 s - long enough to clear 1.2 nm of native oxide, short enough to hold a 3 nm field-oxide budget. Native oxide then regrows in cleanroom air to 0.5 nm in 0.45 h, and that is the queue-time limit. DI/SC-1 rinse: the DLVO barrier decides whether a particle leaves or comes back - SC-1 at pH 10.5 raises a 66 kT barrier and clears them, while the HF tank itself, at pH 2 near the point of zero charge, offers -0.1 kT and particles re-deposit. That is the mechanism reason an HF step is always followed by a rinse. Eight gates green, including the Debye length at 1 mM landing at 9.62 nm against the textbook 9.6.
pois.physics: 食人鱼液靠强氧化把有机物拆成 CO₂ 和水;稀 HF 能「温柔剥氧化层」,是因为它蚀 SiO₂ 快而蚀 Si 慢几个数量级——选择性是湿法化学的全部要义。18.2 MΩ·cm 是 25 ℃ 纯水的理论电阻率极限:水里除了水,几乎什么都不剩。
pois.physics_en: Piranha oxidizes organics all the way to CO2 and water; dilute HF strips oxide gently because it etches SiO2 orders of magnitude faster than Si - selectivity is the whole point of wet chemistry. And 18.2 megohm-cm is the theoretical resistivity limit of pure water at 25 C: nothing left in the water but water.

pois.label: CD-SEM 线宽量测柱
pois.detail: 竖立的电子镜筒往晶圆上打聚焦电子束、收集二次电子成像——光刻显影后的「量身高」:线宽（CD）与套刻偏差在这里读数,超差的批次直接返工,不让错误流向下游。
pois.detail_en: The upright column focuses an electron beam onto the wafer and images with secondary electrons - the post-develop measuring station. Critical dimension and overlay are read here; out-of-spec lots get reworked on the spot instead of passing errors downstream.

specs.原理: 聚焦电子束 + 二次电子探测
specs.量测: 线宽 CD / 套刻 overlay / 侧壁形貌
specs.工位: 显影后 ADI / 刻蚀后 AEI
specs.束压: 低压电子束——防损伤光刻胶

specs_en.Beam: low-voltage - resist must not be damaged by its own inspection

sim: 数字线口径:MB-1 走 sky130 130 nm 节点,光学显微镜已在衍射极限边缘,CD 复检靠电子束;模拟线 CRN65LP 的 29 轮 DRC 是「画出来的规则」,SEM 量测是「做出来的证据」——规则收敛与工艺量测互为闭环。
成像续账（本厂设计轮,三闸:平坦无假边/理想仪器复原 138.0=138.0/帧平均 1/√N）：边缘增亮(二次电子 1/cosθ)+3 nm 束斑+散粒噪声的合成波形上,单帧 σ_CD 1.04 nm、16 帧平均 0.34 nm——量测的重复性预算从此有账;对称判据下偏置为零属模型对称性,真机偏置另有来源(声明)。

18 号仿真是本厂替冷冻电镜实验室回填的**第一个指名数字**,两台真求解器一起上:**Geant4(Allpix² v3.2.0)**算衬底回散射,**Sentaurus TCAD**算耗尽场。关键建模选择:背照减薄后底下**不是硅衬底**(它已被去掉),而是 BEOL 金属层加载片——按 1.5µm 铜 + 4µm 有机介质 + 500µm 硅载片建模,铜比硅回散射更强,所以这是对方担忧的悲观读法。结果:回散射确实多收约一半电荷(+49/57/55% @10/15/25µm),**但对厚度基本平坦**;计数模式真正的代价是分离的伪团簇,14–17%,而且**薄的反而更低**。决定性的一条:对方模型把横向扩散写死 1.8µm,实测一次团簇 Rg 在 15µm 是 **1.66µm(守住)**、在 25µm 是 **3.87µm(击穿)**——**他们推荐的厚度恰恰违反他们自己的假设**。TCAD 侧三个厚度在 20V 全耗尽,扩散 σ 仅 0.73/0.94/1.41µm。**结论:外延 25→15µm 成立。** 闸门 E1 顺带独立复核了对方的数:25µm 无衬底 3152 e⁻ vs 他们的 ~3000,不同代码不同作者,互证成立。
sim_en: Digital-line ledger: MB-1 runs sky130 at 130 nm, right at the optical diffraction edge, so CD verification falls to the e-beam. On the analog line, CRN65LP's 29 DRC iterations are the rules as drawn - SEM metrology is the evidence as built. Rule convergence and fab metrology close each other's loop.

Imaging continuation (this fab's design round; three gates: flat sample shows no false edges, the ideal instrument recovers 138.0 = 138.0 nm, frame averaging follows 1/sqrt(N)): on the synthetic waveform - edge bloom (secondary electrons at 1/cos theta), 3 nm spot, shot noise - single-frame sigma_CD is 1.04 nm and 16-frame averaging reaches 0.34 nm. The metrology repeatability budget is now on the books; zero bias under the symmetric criterion is a model symmetry, real-tool bias has other sources (declared).

Sim 18 is the first number this fab was asked by name to backfill for the cryo-EM lab, and it took two real solvers: Geant4 (via Allpix Squared v3.2.0) for substrate backscatter and Sentaurus TCAD for the depletion field. The modelling choice that matters: after back-side thinning what lies underneath is NOT silicon substrate - that has been removed - but the BEOL metal stack and the carrier, modelled as 1.5 um of copper, 4 um of organic dielectric and a 500 um silicon carrier. Copper backscatters harder than silicon, so this is the pessimistic reading of their worry. Backscatter is real, adding about half again the collected charge (+49/57/55% at 10/15/25 um), but it is essentially flat with thickness; what it actually costs in counting mode is spurious separated clusters, running 14-17% and LOWER on the thin devices. The decisive finding: their model hard-codes 1.8 um of lateral spread, and the measured primary-cluster radius is 1.66 um at 15 um but 3.87 um at 25 um - their recommended thickness is the one that breaks their own assumption. TCAD finds all three thicknesses fully depleted at 20 V with diffusion contributing only 0.73/0.94/1.41 um. The epi can go from 25 to 15 um. Gate E1 also independently reproduces their own number: 3,152 e- at 25 um with no substrate against their ~3,000, from a different code by a different author.
pois.physics: 分辨率由波长定:可见光 ~500 nm,而 1 keV 电子的德布罗意波长 ~0.04 nm——看 130 nm 线条绰绰有余。低压是有意的:高能束会让光刻胶带电、收缩——量测本身不能改变被量测物。
pois.physics_en: Resolution follows wavelength: visible light is ~500 nm, while a 1 keV electron's de Broglie wavelength is ~0.04 nm - margin to spare on 130 nm lines. The low voltage is deliberate: an energetic beam charges and shrinks resist, and a measurement must never alter what it measures.

pois.label: 离子注入机（掺杂工位）
pois.detail: 一条横着的小型加速器:源柜电离掺杂气体,加速管把离子提到数十至数百 keV,分析磁铁按质荷比拐弯甩掉杂离子,只放对的核素进终端台轰进晶圆。光刻胶本身就是注入掩模——所以它站在黄光区:n 阱、p 阱、源漏、阈值调节,晶体管的「配方」全靠一炉炉注入写进硅里。
pois.detail_en: A small accelerator laid on its side: the source cabinet ionizes dopant gas, the column boosts ions to tens or hundreds of keV, the analyzing magnet bends the beam by mass-to-charge and discards everything but the right species, and the end station drives it into the wafer. Photoresist itself is the implant mask - which is why the tool stands in the yellow bay. Wells, source-drain, threshold adjust: a transistor's recipe is written into silicon one implant at a time.

specs.束线: 源柜 → 加速管 → 分析磁铁 → 终端台
specs.倾角: 束线倾 7° 防沟道效应
specs.后续: 快速热退火:激活掺杂 + 修复晶格

specs_en.Beamline: source, accel column, analyzing magnet, end station
specs_en.Energy: tens to hundreds of keV - sets depth
specs_en.After: rapid thermal anneal to activate dopants and heal the lattice

sim: sky130 与 CRN65LP 的器件家族——不同阈值的 NMOS/PMOS、阱区、SPAD 的倍增结剖面——在 PDK 里就是一组组注入条件的产物:MB-1 的 ~2100 个标准单元、SPAD 像素的击穿电压,源头都在这台机器的能量-剂量表里。
射程账（本厂设计轮，LSS 一阶+Schiøtt 投影）：B 30 keV→~114 nm、100 keV→~311 nm；P 30→~46；As 30→~29。对 SRIM 锚点 B/P 在 ±11% 内，As 偏高 +27%（重离子一阶模型的已知偏差，范围声明在案）——「能量定深度」从量级话变成了曲线。
退火续账（本厂设计轮，Deal-Grove/扩散,闸门:公式渐近+剂量守恒+文献锚点）：B 30 keV 注入剖面经 950/1050 °C 半小时退火,结深 224→319 nm——热预算是结深的第二个旋钮;表面要用反射边界,普通高斯会把 9~21% 剂量「漏出晶圆」,守恒闸抓的就是它。

21 号仿真是一条**安全账**,起因是冷冻电镜实验室的城市级提醒:地下城大气里氩占 30.9%,而氩是最容易击穿的常见气体之一,所以地球上的「空气绝缘」数字在这座城里要打折。本厂独立重算而非采信:按组成摩尔加权得 Townsend **B=298.1 V/cm·Torr,比地球空气 365 低 18.3%**——**方向对,但不是他们说的 31%**(那需要 O₂ 的 B≈190,低于任何查表值)。**工程结论不变:必须降额,系数 0.8 而非 0.7。**对这台注入机:300kV 终端在舱内气需均匀气隙 **19.7cm**,×3 工程降额 **59cm**——没有哪个设备罩装得下。**采用 3 bar 本地 CO₂ 方案**:同样 300kV 只需 2.9cm(降额 8.7cm),缩小 6.8 倍;而 CO₂ 是火星大气的 95.1%,进气塔天天在冻它,本地免费,整罐泄空也不构成生保事件。闸门含空气帕邢最低点 305V(文献 250–400)与闭式解机器精度吻合。
sim_en: The device families of sky130 and CRN65LP - NMOS/PMOS at several thresholds, the wells, the SPAD multiplication-junction profile - exist in the PDK as sets of implant conditions. MB-1's ~2100 standard cells and the SPAD pixel's breakdown voltage both trace back to this machine's energy-dose table.

Range ledger (this fab's design round, first-order LSS + Schiott projection): B lands at ~114 nm for 30 keV and ~311 nm for 100 keV; P at ~46 nm, As at ~29 nm for 30 keV. Against SRIM anchor points B and P sit within 11%; As reads 27% high - the known bias of a first-order model for heavy ions, scope declared. 'Energy sets depth' is now a curve, not a slogan.

Anneal continuation (this fab's design round, Deal-Grove + diffusion; gates: formula asymptotics, dose conservation, literature anchors): the 30 keV boron profile annealed at 950-1050 C for 30 min lands junctions at 224-319 nm - thermal budget is the second knob on junction depth. The surface needs a reflecting boundary: a plain Gaussian leaks 9-21% of the dose out of the wafer, which is exactly what the conservation gate caught.

Sim 21 is a SAFETY ledger, prompted by a city-level warning from the cryo-EM lab: argon makes up 30.9% of the underground atmosphere, and argon is among the easiest common gases to break down, so Earth's air-insulation numbers need discounting here. This fab recomputed rather than adopted: mole-weighting the composition gives a Townsend B of 298.1 V/cm/Torr, 18.3% below Earth air's 365 - the direction is right but the discount is not the 31% they carried, which would need oxygen at B = 190, below any tabulated value. The engineering conclusion is unchanged: derate, at 0.8 rather than 0.7. For this implanter, a 300 kV terminal needs a 19.7 cm uniform gap in cabin gas, 59 cm after the standard 3x derating - more than any tool enclosure provides. The 3 bar local CO2 proposal is ADOPTED: the same 300 kV needs only 2.9 cm, 8.7 cm derated, a 6.8x shrink - and CO2 is 95.1% of the Martian atmosphere with the intake tower already freezing it daily, so it is free here, and venting a whole tank is not a life-support event. Gates include the air Paschen minimum at 305 V against the 250-400 literature band, matching the closed form to machine precision.
pois.physics: 注入深度由离子能量与阻止本领定（LSS 射程理论）,浓度由束流积分定——两个旋钮解耦,这是注入取代热扩散的根本原因。倾 7° 是因为硅晶格沿主轴有「通道」,离子会顺缝钻得过深——斜着打,把晶格堵上。
pois.physics_en: Depth is set by ion energy and stopping power (LSS range theory); concentration by integrated beam current - two decoupled knobs, which is exactly why implantation displaced thermal diffusion. The 7-degree tilt exists because the silicon lattice has channels along its axes that let ions tunnel far too deep - tilting the beam closes the view down the corridor.

pois.label: 氧化/退火炉管（热工艺）
pois.detail: 三根石英管里是全厂最古老的化学：高温下硅自己长出二氧化硅，注入的掺杂原子在晶格里扩散就位。石英舟载着一排晶圆缓慢进出——热工艺不赶时间，赶时间的都毁在它手里。
pois.detail_en: Inside the three quartz tubes lives the oldest chemistry in the fab: at temperature, silicon grows its own oxide and implanted dopants diffuse into place in the lattice. The quartz boat glides wafers in and out slowly - thermal steps are never rushed; everything rushed here is ruined.

specs.退火: 注入损伤修复+掺杂激活
specs.控温: 三区独立,Arrhenius 主宰一切

sim: 热工艺账（本厂设计轮 proc_thermal.py,五闸:公式渐近 <1%/湿氧锚点 435≈410 nm/剂量守恒/零退火极限/扩散系数十年段）：干氧 1000 °C 半小时 ≈ 9 nm 栅氧量级,湿氧 1100 °C 一小时近微米场氧;B 30 keV 注入剖面经 950/1000/1050 °C 半小时退火,结深 224/262/319 nm。守恒闸抓获真 bug:高热预算下普通高斯把 9~21% 剂量「漏出晶圆」,表面必须用反射边界。
sim_en: Thermal ledger (this fab's design round, proc_thermal.py; five gates: formula asymptotics <1%, wet-oxide anchor 435 vs ~410 nm, dose conservation, zero-anneal limit, diffusivity decade): dry 1000 C/30 min grows gate-oxide-scale ~9 nm, wet 1100 C/1 h near-micron field oxide; the 30 keV boron profile annealed 30 min lands junctions at 224/262/319 nm for 950/1000/1050 C. The conservation gate caught a real bug - a plain Gaussian leaks 9-21% of the dose out of the wafer at high thermal budget; the surface needs a reflecting boundary.
pois.physics: 氧化的自限性藏在 Deal-Grove 里:氧要穿过已长出的氧化层才能到达界面,越厚越慢——先线性后抛物。扩散是热运动的账:D=D₀e^{−Ea/kT},温度每加 50 °C,原子走得远一倍。
pois.physics_en: Oxidation's self-limiting nature lives in Deal-Grove: oxygen must cross the oxide it has already grown to reach the interface, so thicker means slower - linear first, parabolic later. Diffusion is thermal bookkeeping: D = D0 e^(-Ea/kT); fifty degrees more and the atoms walk twice as far.

pois.label: LPCVD 沉积炉（共形沉积）
pois.detail: 穹顶冷壁腔+三路气源:前驱气体在低压下多次反弹才被表面「收留」,黏附系数越低、反弹越多,深槽底部越能被照顾到——这是溅射台做不到的事,深孔深槽的填充全靠它。
pois.detail_en: A domed cold-wall chamber with three gas lines: at low pressure the precursor bounces many times before a surface finally keeps it - the lower the sticking, the more bounces, the better the bottom of a deep trench is served. Sputtering cannot do this; deep-feature fill belongs to CVD.

specs.机制: 表面反应限制,低黏附多次反弹
specs.对照: PVD 直线飞行=视角因子主宰

specs_en.Mechanism: surface-reaction limited, low sticking, many bounces
specs_en.Contrast: PVD flies line-of-sight - the view factor rules

sim: 沉积账（本厂设计轮 proc_dep_sem.py,蒙卡弹道三闸）：AR2 深槽底,直线飞行的 PVD 只剩 24% 覆盖(=视角因子 0.243,数值 0.244 压到千分位);黏附系数降到 0.03、Lambert 多次反弹后,同一条槽底覆盖回到 0.88——「填深槽用 CVD」从经验变成账。侧壁再发射角度权重写反会让粒子顺墙爬逃,闸门当场抓获。
sim_en: Deposition ledger (this fab's design round, proc_dep_sem.py; Monte-Carlo ballistic, three gates): at the bottom of an AR-2 trench, line-of-sight PVD keeps only 24% coverage (the view factor, 0.243 vs numeric 0.244); drop sticking to 0.03 with Lambert re-emission and the same trench bottom recovers to 0.88 - 'fill deep features with CVD' turned from lore into a ledger line. Swap the re-emission angle weights and particles crawl up the walls and escape - caught by the gate.
pois.physics: 黏附系数是这台机器的灵魂:s→1 是弹道输运(几何阴影),s→0 是分子在腔里反复试探直到处处均匀——共形性不是工艺参数,是一个概率的倒数。
pois.physics_en: The sticking coefficient is this tool's soul: s near 1 is ballistic transport (geometric shadowing), s near 0 lets molecules keep trying until every surface is served equally - conformality is not a recipe knob, it is the reciprocal of a probability.

pois.label: CMP 抛光机（平坦化）
pois.detail: 转盘和载头反向旋转,浆料在中间——机械磨削加化学软化,把沉积后高低不平的表面磨成光刻需要的平面。它在湿区和湿法台作伴:一样用水,一样怕干。
pois.detail_en: Platen and carrier head counter-rotate with slurry in between - mechanical abrasion plus chemical softening grind the post-deposition topography into the flat plane lithography demands. It keeps the wet bench company in the wet corner: same water, same fear of drying out.

specs.图形效应: 局部去除率随有效密度变化(Stine)
specs.浆料: 磨粒+化学(氧化铝/硅溶胶)

specs_en.Mechanism: Preston: removal rate scales with pressure times velocity

sim: CMP 账（本厂设计轮 proc_cmp.py,三闸:均匀零差/核宽自检 258≈250 µm/闭式=数值 176.1 nm）：MB-1 真 die 的 met1 密度图 0.04~0.61,平坦化卷积后抛后厚度差 176 nm——对照光刻焦深 >±2 µm,130 nm 节点 CMP 不卡脖子。fill 反事实拆穿口号:met1 均匀靠电源网格(去 fill 仅差 1.16×),poly 上 decap 把最空的格抬十倍(0.015→0.152)——填充单元的第一身份是均匀性,CMP 只是动机之一。
浆料排放：20 L/sol 经 FeCl₃ 混凝沉降成 SiO₂/Al₂O₃ 滤饼 1.5 kg/sol，回 ops-printer-01 作打印骨料（res-recycle-01 危废间）。
sim_en: CMP ledger (this fab's design round, proc_cmp.py; three gates: uniform-zero, kernel-width self-check 258 vs 250 um, closed form equals numeric at 176.1 nm): the real MB-1 met1 density map spans 0.04-0.61, and after the planarization convolution the post-polish spread is 176 nm - comfortable against the node's >2 um depth of focus. The fill counterfactual dissects the slogan: met1 owes its uniformity to the power grid (removing fill costs only 1.16x), while on poly the decap cells lift the emptiest bins tenfold (0.015 to 0.152) - fill is first about uniformity; CMP is one motive among several.
Slurry effluent: 20 L/sol is FeCl3-coagulated into 1.5 kg/sol of SiO2/Al2O3 filter cake and returned to ops-printer-01 as print aggregate (res-recycle-01 hazmat bay).
pois.physics: Preston 方程说去除率∝压力×相对速度——而图形效应的全部秘密是「压力集中」:凸起面积占比越小,单位面积压强越大,磨得越快。平坦化是压强的自动负反馈。
pois.physics_en: Preston says removal scales with pressure times velocity - and the whole secret of pattern effects is pressure concentration: the smaller the raised-area fraction, the higher the local pressure, the faster it polishes. Planarization is pressure running its own negative feedback.

pois.label: AGV 晶圆物流车（全厂闭环）
pois.detail: 地上驮着透明晶圆舱的小车是产线的血液循环:从充电桩出发给涂胶轨道上片,黄光区流程（涂胶→曝光→显影,机器人在轨道与光刻机之间接驳）走完后接回晶圆,穿过厂房送进 RIE——腔门为它开合——再到探针台与划片机,空车回巢。跟着它走一圈,就把芯片制造流程走了一遍。
pois.detail_en: The little vehicle carrying an open transparent wafer pod is the line's bloodstream: it leaves its charging dock to load the coat track, waits out the yellow-bay sequence (coat, expose, develop - the rail robot shuttles between track and stepper), collects the wafer, crosses the fab to the RIE - whose chamber door swings open for it - then serves the probe station and the dicing saw before returning empty. Follow it one lap and you have walked the chip-making flow.

specs.环线: 装载口 → (轨道↔光刻机=机器人接驳) → RIE → 探针台 → 划片
specs.周期: ~104 s 一圈,首尾闭合（演示压缩;真实 fab 一个批次以周计）
specs.导航: 地面导引光带 + 前向激光避障
specs.舱体: 开顶微环境舱（FOUP 同理）

specs_en.Loop: load port, (track-stepper via rail robot), RIE, probe, dicing
specs_en.Cycle: ~104 s per lap, seamlessly looped (compressed for display; a real lot takes weeks)
specs_en.Nav: floor guide strips + forward lidar puck
specs_en.Pod: open-top mini-environment - same idea as a FOUP

pois.sim: 编舞与灯效同相位:曝光光束只在晶圆上台时亮、等离子体只在腔门关闭后点燃、晶圆图大屏只在探针落下时刷新——因果链在场景里可验证:任意时刻跳入,状态自洽。
pois.sim_en: Choreography and lighting share one phase: the exposure beam fires only while the wafer sits on the stage, the plasma ignites only after the chamber door seals, and the wafer-map screen streams only while the probes are down. The causal chain is verifiable in-scene - jump in at any moment and the state is self-consistent.
pois.physics: 现代 fab 的洁净策略是「人不碰片」:晶圆一生都待在舱与设备腔的微环境里,洁净度只需在舱内维持——比把整间厂房维持到同级洁净便宜几个数量级。物流自动化不是效率问题,是沾污预算问题。
pois.physics_en: The modern fab's cleanliness strategy is that hands never touch wafers: a wafer lives its whole life inside pod and process-chamber micro-environments, so extreme cleanliness only needs to exist inside them - orders of magnitude cheaper than holding a whole building to the same class. Fab automation is not an efficiency play; it is a contamination budget.

pois.label: 产线大屏（晶圆图 + MB-1 版图）
pois.detail: 左侧是在测晶圆的实时晶圆图,红色坏品在闪;右侧是 MB-1 的版图示意——四块粉色是 SRAM 宏(占掉 64% 面积),中缝绿色是全部 ~2100 个标准单元。「面积由存储主导」这件事,一屏看懂。
pois.detail_en: Left: the live wafer map of the lot under test, rejects blinking red. Right: the MB-1 floorplan - four pink blocks are the SRAM macros eating 64% of the die, the green strip in the middle is all ~2100 standard cells. That memory dominates area is legible in one glance.

specs.晶圆图: 逐 die 测试结果,绿良品/红淘汰
specs.MB-1: 1.79 mm²,4 SRAM 宏 2×2 阵列 + 中缝逻辑
specs.口径: 良率与 die 分布全部来自探针台实测流

specs_en.Wafer map: per-die test verdicts, green pass / red reject
specs_en.MB-1: 1.79 mm2, 2x2 SRAM macro array with a logic spine
specs_en.Source: yield and die maps stream straight from the probe station

sim: MB-1 P&R 落库口径:OpenROAD floorplan 1660×1080 µm、CTS+hold 修复、TritonRoute 详细布线过天线检查——大屏上的每个色块都对应 GDS 里一层真实几何。
良率反演（本厂设计轮）：这张图 37 die 中 4 淘汰（Y=89.2%）+ MB-1 die 0.0179 cm² → 泊松模型反推缺陷密度 D₀≈6.4 /cm²；同一 D₀ 下 die 放大 10 倍,良率跌到 32%——「小 die 赢良率」的定量版,就写在这块屏上。

CMP 平坦度账（本厂设计轮，Stine 密度模型,三闸:均匀零差/核宽自检 258≈250 µm/闭式=数值）：MB-1 met1 密度图 0.04~0.61,平坦化卷积后抛后厚度差 176 nm——对照光刻焦深 >±2 µm,130 nm 节点 CMP 不卡脖子。反事实拆穿了口号:met1 均匀靠 PDN(去 fill 只差 1.16×),poly 上 decap 把空洞密度抬十倍(0.015→0.152)——填充单元的第一身份是均匀性,CMP 只是动机之一。
sim_en: MB-1 P&R ledger: OpenROAD floorplan at 1660x1080 um, CTS with hold fixing, TritonRoute detailed routing past antenna checks - every color block on this screen maps to real geometry in the GDS.

Yield inversion (this fab's design round): this very map shows 4 rejects out of 37 dies (Y = 89.2%); with MB-1's 0.0179 cm2 die, the Poisson model inverts to a defect density D0 of about 6.4 per cm2 - and at the same D0 a die ten times larger would yield 32%. 'Small dies win' is quantified on this screen.

CMP planarity ledger (this fab's design round, Stine density model; three gates: uniform-zero, kernel-width self-check 258 vs 250 um, closed-form equals numeric): MB-1's met1 density map spans 0.04-0.61, and after the planarization convolution the post-CMP thickness spread is 176 nm - comfortable against the >2 um litho depth of focus at this node. The counterfactual dissects the slogan: met1 owes its uniformity to the power grid (removing fill costs only 1.16x), while on poly the decap cells lift the emptiest bins tenfold (0.015 to 0.152) - fill cells are first about uniformity; CMP is only one of the motives.
pois.physics: 版图即物理:SRAM 宏是六管位元的密铺,逻辑区是标准单元行——芯片设计的最后一步不是代码,是把布尔代数安放进硅的晶格坐标系。
pois.physics_en: Layout is physics: SRAM macros are tilings of six-transistor bitcells, the logic area is rows of standard cells - the last step of chip design is not code but settling Boolean algebra into silicon's coordinate grid.
